en.question: Which statement about max_tokens is correct?

options.text: It reserves capacity and is billed in full whether or not it is consumed.
options.note: There is no reservation charge for an unused ceiling.

options.text: It sets the size of the context window available to the request.
options.note: The context window is a model property, not a per-request output limit.

options.text: It bounds generated tokens; reaching it yields stop_reason "max_tokens".
It limits how many tool calls the model is permitted to make in a turn.
options.note: Tool call count is not governed by max_tokens.

en.explanation: It caps output length and billing follows tokens actually produced. Hitting the cap truncates the response and reports it in stop_reason, which your code should detect rather than assume completeness.
